future_check: The old generator's 100% output uniqueness was not semantic evidence: exact complete-profile coverage was zero and up to 34.3% of easy draws silently had only one frame. Final ratings lead with the stricter linked census and exact-count repair.; Absolute scene translation, seed color labels, token coordinates, and whole-scene horizontal/vertical reflection are excluded from the complete profile because the oracle is equivariant to them. Frame geometry, token value, and seed offset remain linked.; The general default intentionally keeps the public horizontal two-frame topology and uses a 30% five-profile anchor. It broadens nuisance and semantic branches substantially but is rated coverage/diversity tier 3, not 4.; One-frame scenes are a lawful explicit edge rather than a default branch because every public input has two independent frames. The current override matrix and real-Racket parity cover it.; The previous no_frames/no_token/no_seed textures produced rule-no-op lessons unrelated to the public training manifold and were unreferenced outside this module. They were removed instead of special-casing invalid checker grammars.; Racket linter reports only style-outer-wrapper, dummy-let, not-equal, and zero-predicate suggestions. rationale: VERSION 2.0.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced retry-only frame placement with constructive one- or two-frame layouts that always realize the requested/default count or reject an impossible explicit combination.; Corrected the canonical frame family from 4..5 square-ish frames to 5..7 rows by 4..6 columns, covering every public 5/6/7-height and 4/5-width case.; Added five linked archetypes retaining grid dimensions, relative frame layout and size, token value, and seed offset; only translation, seed color labels, token position, and whole-scene horizontal/vertical reflection are nuisance.; Added canonical_profile_signature, is_canonical_profile, observe_overrides, rule_mirror, and a strict self_check.; Default generalized scenes use distinct tokens and seed colors across two frames, cover all token pairs, and deliberately mix unclipped and one-clipped outputs; clipped and centered textures force the two extremes.; Removed dead palette_size, position_bias, n_distinct_colors, density, and rule-no-op degenerates from AXES; retained only executable dimensions, frame count, palette, and texture controls.; Palette kinds now select real seed-color pools; texture palette aliases execute and record the matching palette; explicit texture=none is byte-identical to omission.; Strict validation rejects unknown controls, invalid difficulty/enums, bool-as-int, non-integer numeric axes, and conflicting palette aliases.; Pinned RULE_HASH=efb277668cb4 and added eight focused regression groups covering all public pairs, main/disjoint profiles, semantic branches, boundaries, provenance, checker mutations, negative recombination, determinism, fresh returns, and global RNG isolation.
summary: Find each complete color-1 rectangular frame. In its strict interior, token 2 selects a five-cell plus kernel, token 3 a five-cell X kernel, and token 4 a full 3x3 kernel. Erase all non-frame input marks, then paint the selected kernel in the other interior cell's seed color, centered on that seed and clipped to the strict frame interior. Frames are processed independently.
